tasks.acceptance_prose:
## Background
This repo has a Word-parity contract layer: `tests/parity/word-parity-overrides.json` + drop-ins in
`tests/parity/overrides-dropins/*.json` define executable UI contracts keyed by ledger binding tokens;
`tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs` runs them against the live editor (playwright triggers a control and
asserts the effect). Your worktree is branched from main at d244c4bab — the layer currently has
68 passing contracts / 3 known-gap / 0 FAIL.

## Deliverable
ONE new file: `tests/parity/overrides-dropins/ctx-parag.json`. Touch NOTHING else. Shape:
{"entries": {"<key>": {...}}, "$skipped": [{"row": "...", "reason": "..."}]} ($skipped optional).
Key = the row's binding TOKEN OR the FEATURE ID — use the FEATURE ID whenever two ledger rows share a token.
Entry fields (READ tests/parity/overrides-dropins/pilot2.json + word-parity-overrides.json for live examples):
- "effektClass": one of dialog|format|structure|op|view.
- Trigger — exactly ONE of:
  * "selector": CSS of the control to click, default '[data-cmd="<token>"]'. Scope by
    '.ribbon-page[data-tab="<tab>"] [data-cmd=...]' when the data-cmd is duplicated (first match wins).
  * "key": a keyboard chord like "Control+f" / "Control+Shift+Space" / "Alt+;" / "F1" (playwright
    notation: https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-keyboard — Control/Alt/Shift/Meta + key name).
    With "key", NO selector is needed or checked.
- "pre": state prerequisite — 'file-menu' (backstage), 'list' (ordered-list fixture),
  'ctx-menu' (right-click inside the selection to open #ctx-menu; selector then clicks a
  '[data-ctx="..."]' item), 'ctx-menu-in-list' (list fixture THEN right-click), 'ctx-menu-in-table'
  (2x2 table fixture THEN right-click), 'backstage:<pane>'. ctx items live at '#ctx-menu [data-ctx="X"]'.
- "assertion": dialog => {"kind":"dialog-visible","dialogSelector":"#<id>"} + REQUIRED "subFeatures"
  [{"name","selector"}] checked INSIDE the visible dialog (one missing = FAIL — list only real ids);
  format => {"kind":"computed-style","prop":"text-align","equals":"center"} (on the first word's element
  — placeCaret selected it); text insert => {"kind":"text-mutation","selector":"#editor","contains":"…"}
  or {"containsDate":true}; dom change => {"kind":"dom-mutation","selector":"#editor tr:nth-child(3)"};
  doc-level toggle => {"kind":"viewport-flag","rootSelector":"main","hasClass":"x"} or
  {"rootSelector":"#editor","prop":"zoom","equals":"1.1"}.
- "post": optional selector clicked after the assertion (reset state: "#btn-zoom-reset", dialog close).
- "xfail": true + "note" when the row is a REAL parity gap (control exists, promised effect never
  appears) — counts as known-gap, never FAIL. Prefer honest xfail over silent dropping; list genuinely
  uncontractable rows under "$skipped" with a reason instead of faking them.
- "note": cite the ledger feature id.
- woTab for ribbon controls (home|insert|layout|references|review|view|collaboration|draw|protection|
  plugins|ai|chart-design|header-footer); omit for ctx/statusbar/dialog triggers.

## Non-negotiable workflow
1. READ word-parity-overrides.json examples ('bold','toggledropcap'), overrides-dropins/pilot2.json
   (ctx-menu-in-list, ctx-menu-in-table, key examples), contract-runner.cjs (pre chain + checkEffect).
2. GREP-BEFORE-TRUST: verify every control/item id, its data-showif gating, its click handler, and the
   dialog it opens in apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html + editor.js. Rows whose handler
   needs state your pre cannot build (e.g. a link at the caret) => xfail with that exact reason.
3. Write the JSON; from the worktree root run:
   bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh $((68 + PASSING))
   (PASSING = non-xfail entries you committed). Exit 0 required; iterate. /usr/bin/node only.
   Never install anything; the docserver binary + playwright are provided.
4. Commit ONLY your drop-in file, message: feat(L2D): <what you contracted>.

## Your rows (from the parity ledger census)

All with pre 'ctx-menu' (right-click opens the menu; selector = '#ctx-menu [data-ctx="<Action>"]').
Grep index.html for the exact data-ctx values and editor.js for each handler + the dialog it opens:
- ctx.insert-caption (Caption item) — which dialog? (#? caption dialog; grep Caption handler)
- ctx.paragraph-advanced-settings — likely ParagraphSettings -> #paragraph-settings-dialog
- ctx.drop-cap-settings — DropcapSettings -> #dropcap-dialog
- ctx.horizontal-line-settings — grep HR settings item/handler
- ctx.table-advanced-settings (table-gated? data-showif=table -> use pre ctx-menu-in-table)
- ctx.table-of-contents-settings — TocSettings -> #updatetoc-dialog or #toc-dialog
- ctx.equation-settings — grep the item + dialog
- ctx.create-new-style — grep the item + handler
Expected: >=5 passing (gate 68 + actual). xfail gated-invisible rows with the gating reason.
